normal.name: Eerie Games
normal.text: What's cozy, magical, and playable SOLO? A Faraway Tower! Coming in February for zine month, you play as the iconic Princess in the Tower with a twist! Your new home was a mage's tower and it's full of arcane knowledge just waiting to break free. Play your cards right and you could break free too!

normal.text: 🎀 What am I thankful for? I’m thankful for ROCKS 🪨 ✨ I am so thankful for everyone here and still sticking around while I’m on hiatus! Wishing you and your family/chosen family a restful, peaceful, and plentiful day full of delicious food and laughs 🧡 Abigail - Stardew Valley PC @ milksloth.photos
"Chores? In my video games?" Yes. Stardew Valley isn't even the first game of its genre by a couple decades. Now go back to screaming the N word because someone didn't rush B or whatever.

normal.name: 🚬⛓️Talenn🐕🎀
normal.text: IS THIS THE PIRATE COVE ONE?!?!??!?!?!?!?! I PLAYED THIS AS A KID AND IN HIGH SCHOOL A MILLION TIMES. It's a HUGE source of inspiration, and the playful, exciting, and still cozy feeling of ISpy books and games is something I try to recreate when I make any art!!!

normal.name: Dorian Dawes
normal.text: Yeah I think that is where I fall on this too. I like a lotta cute shit. I like games like Travellers Rest and enjoy lighthearted whimsy. What I don't like is this callous cruelty masquerading as wholesome.

normal.name: CatKraft
normal.text: New to farming games? CatKraft eases you in with a story. Granny Clover leaves you her farm, and Old Tom teaches you the game in ten short chapters. Already know your way around a hoe? Skip a step, or turn the story off in the Esc menu. https://catkraft.heartofalion.games/
normal.media: link card: CatKraft: a cat farming adventure

normal.name: Luca Salami
normal.text: I'm a touch resentful of people treating the old games like there was nothing like special about them. They've always been more than just a violence sim. They've always had things to say about american life. I know it's been 13 years, but we don't need revisionism to give the new one flowers.

normal.name: Philby Bear
normal.text: Which is an *odd* tact to take, even for an ostensibly cozy RPG? Not helping that the game doesn't meaningfully distinguish in its dialogue options which ones are pro-humanity and which are pro-nihilism.

heated.name: Aurora B. Cosmos
heated.text: Enamelist is in Fresh Tier “A fun little tidy up game tailor made for me. I love enamel pins so I was delighted by this game. I like having a game where each object is unique and the fact that it isn’t made with AI is really nice. Unlike a lot of games in this subgenre.”
